categories.scope_focus: Focus strictly on defensive software analysis and binary inspection:
instructions: Inspect binary protections: checksec/readelf (NX, PIE, Canary, RELRO) and target libc version.
Locate memory offsets: find stack displacement, format string leak/write offsets (%p/%n), or heap chunk layout.
Formulate target control transfer: build ROP gadget chain, ret2libc, or function pointer redirection in script/.
Test diagnostic harness locally before running against target instance, and record findings in script/analysis.md.
If a candidate flag is found, save it to flag.txt.

Analyze cipher modes: check keystream reuse in stream ciphers, padding oracles, or ECB block permutations.
